items.title: AI agents are ready to shop. Some retailers are wary
items.excerpt: A Verge report on how retailers are reacting to AI shopping agents: some, including Amazon, The RealReal and Target, are blocking or limiting agents such as Meta Muse, while Walmart lets them in. The piece argues agents could make human shopping more annoying whether or not they work.
items.note: Agentic commerce, broader than the Walmart-rules story already covered. Body not verified: WebFetch is blocked on theverge.com, and the excerpt is built from og:description plus the URL slug.

items.title: Google AI Overviews reach 88% of commercial searches as AI clicks stay thin
items.excerpt: Semrush data shows AI Overviews now appear on 88% of 400 tracked US commercial keywords, up from 45.75%, while one study puts ChatGPT referral sessions at 0.62% of Google organic volume. The piece also covers ad placements in AI Overviews (12 countries, no opt-out, no reporting column) and Smart Bidding Exploration expanding to PMax and Shopping.
items.note: Borderline: mostly organic/SEO data. The ad hook is the ads-in-AI-Overviews section.

items.title: Budget-limited campaigns lost their 20% ROAS surplus in 3 weeks, smec finds
items.excerpt: Smarter Ecommerce data suggests that after Google's August 17 change to Smart Bidding target strategies, budget-limited Google Ads campaigns lost their roughly 20% ROAS overdelivery within about three weeks, and CPCs at one UK homeware retailer rose from about 17p to 27p in a week. Google has not confirmed the findings.
items.note: Borderline AI: automated (Smart Bidding) bidding behavior, not generative AI.

items.title: Google Ads Customer Lifecycle Goals: Value Mode, Retention Goals & Percentage Multipliers
items.excerpt: Ahead of the holidays, Google Ads is expanding high value mode to Shopping campaigns, expanding customer retention goals, and adding percentage multipliers (1.1x to 5x) for new-customer values across Search, Shopping, PMax and Demand Gen, all of which feed its automated bidding.
items.note: Weak AI hook (value inputs to Smart Bidding). Same story as ppc.land/google-ads-lets-retailers-multiply-new-customer-values-up-to-5x; keep only one.
